game_concept: A speed quiz set in Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault, a hidden relic vault: the rune scholar must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Length Limit: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Relic Vault.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault: a hidden relic vault
core_gameplay_loop: In Relic Vault, repeat each round: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Relic Vault. Each round, a new moon crystals challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the capacity value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 550 points of moon crystals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 550, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Length Limit
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Length Limit' (Week 7 slot 9), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Relic Vault'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how capacity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Relic Vault.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 550 within 43 seconds.
